sources.name: FINN
sources.note: Current FINN adverts were searched and original pages opened. New verified matches include Golar LNG's shipping-focused internship and Boreal's junior procurement/accounting engagement; Hapro remains open through 6 October.

sources.name: NAV Arbeidsplassen
sources.note: Current NAV listings were searched and original pages opened. ColliCare's graduate-friendly logistics controller role was added. DOF is now explicitly inactive, and both EY adverts were closed after their 5 October 12:00 deadline.

sources.name: Jobbnorge
sources.note: Public Jobbnorge results were searched, but no new relevant advert with sufficiently readable qualification details was verified. Coverage remains partial.

sources.name: Academic Work
sources.note: Public Academic Work listings were checked. A relevant Oracle ERP programme requires 3–6 years of work experience, so it was not added as a junior match; coverage remains partial.

sources.name: LinkedIn
sources.note: Public LinkedIn listings were checked for discovery. Results either duplicated employer adverts or lacked a uniquely verifiable original page; no LinkedIn-only record was added.

sources.name: Employer careers
sources.note: Employer career pages were searched. Norges Bank Investment Management's official 2027 internship advert was verified and added; Accenture's relevant internship had already reached its deadline.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027
jobs.summary: Work on an AI-related project inside an investment-fund team while contributing to its day-to-day work. Finance and business-oriented students can apply alongside technical disciplines.
jobs.requirements: Open to current or formally accepted bachelor’s, master’s, MBA or PhD students with no more than two years of full-time experience. Some AI skills and valid work authorization are required; no minimum study year or prior professional experience is stated.

jobs.title: Operational Controller
jobs.summary: Follow transport revenue, costs, invoicing and profitability while supporting reporting, month-end work and process improvements in an international logistics company.
jobs.requirements: Relevant higher education in economics; new graduates are explicitly welcome. Excel, systems understanding and Norwegian and English are required; prior experience is not stated as mandatory.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027
jobs.summary: Shipping and offshore internship with real projects; business students can target business development or ESG work alongside technical project tracks.
jobs.requirements: Third- or fourth-year student in business or another relevant discipline. Strong English required; Norwegian is helpful but not mandatory. State the preferred project in the application.

jobs.title: Administrasjon · Innkjøp og regnskap
jobs.summary: Support supplier records, purchase-order follow-up, accounts payable and routine procurement controls in a transport group through summer 2027.
jobs.requirements: Suitable for a gap-year candidate or new graduate; no specific degree is required. Relevant office, customer-service, warehouse or administrative experience is advantageous but not mandatory. Rolling deadline; recruitment is continuous.

jobs.title: Commercial Graduate 2027
jobs.summary: Commercial work across pricing, bids and contract delivery in offshore projects. A clear connection between business studies and the maritime industry.
jobs.requirements: Accepts bachelor’s or master’s in business, law, finance or related fields; 0–2 years of experience. English required. Confirm graduation and start dates.

jobs.title: Business Operations Executive
jobs.summary: Work with marine insurance documentation, premiums and client portfolios, collaborating with finance and underwriting teams.
jobs.requirements: Business/economics higher education OR three years of relevant experience. Strong Excel and professional Norwegian and English.

jobs.title: Logistikkoordinator
jobs.summary: Coordinate international transport, delivery schedules and customs documentation, with responsibility for customer projects.
jobs.requirements: Relevant logistics education or experience; the profile also asks for logistics experience. Excel, Norwegian/English and class B driving licence.

jobs.title: Supply Planner
jobs.summary: Translate demand into purchasing plans and manage supplier deliveries, inventory parameters and incoming transport.
jobs.requirements: At least two years of relevant goods-flow planning experience. Supply chain, logistics or economics education; Norwegian and English.

jobs.title: Befrakter · Terminal Berger
jobs.summary: Coordinate freight bookings, load planning and customer updates, balancing transport capacity and commercial performance.
jobs.requirements: Experience in transport, logistics, forwarding or operational planning expected. Norwegian communication and digital planning skills.

jobs.title: Trainee innen innkjøp
jobs.summary: Support purchase orders, supplier administration and commercial agreements alongside your studies.
jobs.requirements: Specifically seeks a first-year master’s student in economics, logistics or technology. A BBA alone does not meet this stated requirement.

jobs.title: Salg- og kundekonsulent
jobs.summary: An early-career banking role focused on insurance sales, customer service and some loan administration. Relevant for business graduates interested in customer-facing commercial work.
jobs.requirements: Completed relevant bachelor’s degree and some telephone-sales experience; insurance sales experience may compensate for education. Fluent Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Deadline 2 October shown on the matching NAV advert.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027
jobs.summary: Summer placements across departments and project teams. Selected staff and support functions are open to a wider range of educational backgrounds.
jobs.requirements: Primarily aimed at science, technology and engineering students. Staff/support opportunities are mentioned, but a specific BBA-compatible placement and its requirements are not confirmed. Check available departments before applying.

jobs.title: Global Finance Trainee 2027
jobs.summary: A two-year finance and business programme with rotations in strategy, controlling, accounting, commercial management and business analysis, including one rotation outside Norway.
jobs.requirements: Mandatory relevant master’s completed by summer 2027, preferably in business administration, finance or economics. Maximum two years of full-time experience, strong academic results and fluent English.

jobs.title: Maritime Advisory Trainee 2027
jobs.summary: A two-year maritime advisory programme with three rotations, client projects and exposure to operational performance, fleet strategy and the wider shipping value chain.
jobs.requirements: Mandatory relevant master’s completed by July 2027, strong analytical and communication skills, interest in maritime work and fluent English. A BBA alone does not meet the stated degree requirement.

jobs.title: Summer Intern 2027
jobs.summary: Work on a mentored independent project in capital management, with possible exposure to risk analysis, fund analysis, valuation, data and responsible investment.
jobs.requirements: At least the first year of higher education completed, good academic results and interest in finance. CV plus transcript or diploma are mandatory. No completed degree or prior finance experience is stated as required.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027
jobs.location: Oslo, Karmøy and other Norway locations
jobs.summary: More than 40 internships, including logistics projects, sourcing and trading, logistics performance, energy strategy, inbound shipping and outbound logistics.
jobs.requirements: Minimum three years of completed studies and good academic results. Part-time or voluntary experience is an advantage, not stated as mandatory. Confirm when the three-year threshold is measured.

jobs.title: Deltidsstilling i økonomiavdelingen
jobs.type: Part time · Student · 1–2 days per week
jobs.summary: Student-friendly finance administration covering invoice registration, checks and other administrative tasks, with training and hours adapted to studies.
jobs.requirements: Economics or administration studies are preferred but not mandatory, and the advert says study progress is not decisive. No experience requirement is stated. Deadline is not shown on the original page and may be rolling.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027
jobs.summary: A student team explores a real business challenge from insight and analysis through testing and presentation, potentially involving new business opportunities, AI or technology.
jobs.requirements: For business development, economics, technology or related students who finish a bachelor in spring 2027, or have started or are completing a master. The formal FINN deadline is 15 October; the advert body also says 16 October, so use the earlier date.

jobs.title: Storebrand Summer Internship · Sandbox 2027
jobs.summary: Ten students work in interdisciplinary teams on a real Storebrand challenge spanning finance, innovation, technology and customer experience, then present the solution internally.
jobs.requirements: Open to students currently in the final bachelor year or first master year. Good academic results are required; relevant part-time work or volunteering is advantageous. CV and transcript or diploma are required, but no cover letter.

jobs.title: Graduate Development Programme 2027 · Commercial
jobs.summary: A commercial graduate scheme with placements in project cost control, tendering, HSSEQ or HR, combining practical offshore-energy work with training and networking.
jobs.requirements: Accepts BSc, MSc or MBA backgrounds including administration, economics, finance, business and legal studies. No prior experience requirement is stated; background checks require consent.

jobs.title: Maritime Trainee 2027 · Corporate track
jobs.summary: Corporate-track rotations can cover contracts, insurance, supply-chain projects, compliance, finance and commercial support in an international maritime company.
jobs.requirements: Mandatory relevant master’s degree in business, finance, supply chain, law or similar; 0–2 years of experience and fluent English. A bachelor’s alone does not meet the stated requirement.

jobs.title: Graduate 2027 · Logistics and Procurement
jobs.summary: A graduate role focused on logistics, value-chain and procurement improvement projects, including daily operational follow-up at Hydro Årdal.
jobs.requirements: Mandatory master’s in supply chain, logistics, economics or similar; maximum two years of post-graduation experience and professional Norwegian and English.

jobs.title: Storebrand Trainee 2027
jobs.summary: Three rotations across finance, technology, sustainability and business development, with work ranging from strategic projects to customer analysis and digital products.
jobs.requirements: Mandatory relevant master’s degree, good academic results, maximum three years of experience and strong Norwegian and English. A bachelor’s alone does not meet the stated requirement.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027
jobs.summary: A paid interdisciplinary internship solving a real business case from idea to delivery, with possible work in strategy, user research and data analysis.
jobs.requirements: For students in economics, business development, strategy, technology or engineering who start their final study year in autumn 2027. Interest in technology and problem-solving is required; no prior work experience is stated.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027 · Business Support
jobs.type: Summer internship · Six to eight weeks
jobs.summary: Business-support internship with possible assignments in HR, reporting, data quality, process improvement or risk and compliance.
jobs.requirements: Currently studying for a relevant bachelor’s or master’s and must have completed at least two years of higher education before the internship. Fluent English and a valid Norwegian work permit are mandatory.

jobs.title: Graduate 2027 · Commercial Business Solutions
jobs.summary: Commercial analytics role supporting reports, data models and process improvements across finance, sales, logistics and credit management.
jobs.requirements: Mandatory relevant master’s in business analytics, finance, economics, engineering or similar. SQL or Python, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud and fluent English are required.

jobs.title: Innkjøper
jobs.summary: Procurement work covering IKT purchases, order and invoice follow-up, supplier coordination and advice to internal teams and projects.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor’s in economics or administration, or compensating relevant experience. At least one year of purchasing, logistics or economics experience is mandatory, and the candidate must qualify for HEMMELIG and NATO SECRET security clearance.

jobs.title: Innkjøper
jobs.summary: Own purchasing, supplier follow-up, inventory control and operational logistics across SafeClean locations, with reporting and process-improvement work.
jobs.requirements: Relevant education is desired, but experience can compensate. Experience in purchasing, logistics, supply chain or inventory management, supplier follow-up and negotiations, ERP systems, Excel, and Norwegian and English is expected; no exact minimum years are stated.

jobs.title: Innkjøpere
jobs.summary: Purchasing and contract-administration work covering call-offs, requisitions, invoices, deliveries and supplier follow-up in the defence sector, with structured training for new graduates.
jobs.requirements: Minimum bachelor’s in economics, logistics, administration or another relevant field. Prior purchasing, public-procurement or SAP experience is desirable rather than mandatory. Norwegian and English are required, and candidates must qualify for HEMMELIG and NATO SECRET security clearance.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027
jobs.summary: Work in a small student team on current renewable-energy business cases, with economics, finance, accounting, business analytics and entrepreneurship among the accepted study areas.
jobs.requirements: For students with one or two years remaining in higher education from autumn 2026. Economics-related bachelor or master studies are accepted. CV, transcript, video response, aptitude test and background/personnel checks are required; no prior work experience is stated.

jobs.title: Nyutdannet Forretningsrådgivning 2027
jobs.summary: Business-consulting graduate role focused on process improvement, organisational change and the intersection of technology and business across several Norwegian offices.
jobs.requirements: For candidates graduating in spring 2027 with at least a bachelor’s in economics, management, technology or security. Norwegian is required, along with interest in digitalisation and consulting. Maximum one year of relevant post-degree experience.

jobs.title: Business Consulting Graduate 2027
jobs.summary: Graduate consulting across business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, with work spanning planning, procurement, production, warehousing, distribution and strategy.
jobs.requirements: Higher education must be completed by summer 2027; the advert does not state that a master’s is mandatory. Strong Norwegian and English are required. An aptitude test and separate video application must be completed. Deadline is 5 October at 12:00.

jobs.title: Risk Consulting Graduate 2027
jobs.summary: Graduate consulting focused on governance, internal control, business-process improvement and risk management, including work with banking, finance and insurance clients.
jobs.requirements: Higher education must be completed by summer 2027; the advert does not state that a master’s is mandatory. Norwegian and English are required. An aptitude test and separate video application must be completed. Deadline is 5 October at 12:00.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027 · Strategy & Management
jobs.location: Bergen, Oslo, Stavanger and other Norway locations
jobs.summary: Strategy and management internship with a Supply Chain Management Commercial track in Bergen, Oslo or Stavanger, plus project-management and commercial sustainability options.
jobs.requirements: Open to bachelor’s, master’s or PhD students. At least two years of higher education must be completed before the internship and at least one study year must remain afterwards. Fluent English, a valid Norwegian work permit and no more than two years of relevant full-time experience are required; Equinor does not sponsor visas or relocation for most locations.

jobs.title: Prosjektplanlegger / Innkjøper
jobs.summary: Graduate-friendly maritime role combining project planning, procurement, supplier follow-up, delivery coordination and project-cost tracking for ship-interior projects.
jobs.requirements: Higher education in logistics, economics, procurement, project management, maritime studies or a related field. Newly graduated candidates are explicitly encouraged; some years of experience are also accepted but not mandatory. Norwegian and English plus solid digital skills are required.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027 · Finance & Trading
jobs.summary: Finance and trading internship with placements in Market Analysis and Trading in Bergen or Finance and Control in Oslo and Stavanger.
jobs.requirements: Open to bachelor’s, master’s or PhD students with a good academic record. At least two years of higher education must be completed before the internship and at least one study year must remain afterwards. Fluent English, a valid Norwegian work permit and no more than two years of relevant full-time experience are required; Equinor does not sponsor visas or relocation for most locations.

jobs.title: VARD Graduate Programme 2027
jobs.summary: A permanent maritime graduate role with onboarding, networking and learning across VARD, including finance, procurement and project-management opportunities in Vard Interiors.
jobs.requirements: For students graduating in 2027 in finance, project management or another field relevant to the maritime industry. English communication is required; no master’s degree or prior work experience is stated. A background check or security clearance may be required.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027 · Oslo
jobs.summary: Work with shipbrokers and analysts on market research, commercial activity and live shipping or offshore opportunities across market analysis and broking teams.
jobs.requirements: Open to undergraduate students. Strong academic performance, English fluency, analytical and numerical ability, commercial awareness, a demonstrated interest in shipping or offshore markets, and the right to work in Oslo are required. The employer page is active; the 2 October deadline was cross-checked on NHH’s public student job board.

jobs.title: Innkjøpskoordinator
jobs.summary: Entry-level purchasing coordination covering purchase orders, supplier follow-up, delivery timing, material flow, inventory and reporting in an electronics manufacturer.
jobs.requirements: Education or experience in purchasing, logistics or administration is helpful but explicitly not required. Norwegian and English, solid IT skills, and interest in ERP systems and Excel are required. Detailed training is offered and applicants are assessed continuously.

jobs.title: Økonomi- og revisjonsmedarbeider
jobs.summary: Junior economics and audit role with client work, financial analysis, structured training and gradually increasing responsibility.
jobs.requirements: Higher education in economics, accounting, auditing or business administration is preferred, but the employer says the exact academic background is not decisive. New graduates are welcome; prior experience is not mandatory.

jobs.title: Regnskapsfører
jobs.summary: Broad accounting role across Hatteland group companies, covering bookkeeping, payroll, month-end work, annual accounts, reporting and internal advice in an industrial and maritime group.
jobs.requirements: A bachelor’s degree in business administration or another relevant field is required. Accounting or payroll experience is advantageous but not mandatory, and newly graduated applicants are explicitly encouraged. Norwegian communication is required.

jobs.title: Økonom / Revisor
jobs.summary: Two public-sector economics and audit positions conducting business controls, risk assessments and decisions in multidisciplinary teams, with work adapted to the successful candidates’ experience.
jobs.requirements: A completed bachelor’s in economics, accounting or auditing is required, although documented equivalent competence may sometimes substitute. Relevant experience is helpful but not mandatory; new graduates or students finishing by January are explicitly welcome. Norwegian and accounting knowledge are required.

jobs.title: Wilhelmsen Summer Internship 2027
jobs.summary: An interdisciplinary maritime project involving data analysis, strategy development and presentations on real shipping-industry challenges.
jobs.requirements: Open to students in economics, business and other disciplines; students expected to graduate in 2028 are prioritized but this is not stated as mandatory. A valid Norwegian work permit for the internship is required. The six-week programme runs in weeks 24–26 and 30–32.
